status: exploratory extension frozen after inspecting E0 Bolt-Tiny outcomes and before inspecting any E1 outputs
motivation: E0 Bolt-Tiny did not support added fallback complexity. Test a simpler temporal-alignment baseline rather than tune a gate on the test set.
cohort: all E0 test tail cases, identical IDs, targets, scales and model revisions

methods.bridge: Use only the observed prefix of the E0 336-hour context, forecast k+24 hours from the last observed time, and retain positions k:k+24. No older observations, hidden outage values, fitted selector, or labels are passed into inference.
methods.clock_blind_control: Deliberately forecast only 24 hours from the same shortened prefix and compare to the outer target. This is a labelled misaligned negative control, NOT a deployment method or a novel improvement.

aggregation: same fixed-domain balancing and paired-origin block bootstrap as E0
restrictions: no gate retraining or threshold tuning
no confirmatory claim on reused test origins
no claim that bridge forecasting itself is novel
long-horizon checkpoint limitations must be disclosed
